mapper.select: /* 배치별 마지막 실행 조회 */ SELECT BTCH_EXCN_HSTRY_SN , BTCH_SE_CD , EXCN_SE_CD , EXCN_RSLT_CD , MBR_SN , EXCN_BGNG_DT , EXCN_END_DT , PRCS_CNT , FAIL_RSN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT FROM BTCH_EXCN_HSTRY WHERE BTCH_EXCN_HSTRY_SN IN (SELECT MAX(BTCH_EXCN_HSTRY_SN) FROM BTCH_EXCN_HSTRY GROUP BY BTCH_SE_CD)

/* 배치 실행 이력 목록 조회 */ SELECT H.BTCH_EXCN_HSTRY_SN , H.EXCN_BGNG_DT , H.EXCN_END_DT , H.PRCS_CNT , H.FAIL_RSN , H.EXCN_SE_CD , H.EXCN_RSLT_CD , M.MBR_NCNM FROM BTCH_EXCN_HSTRY H LEFT JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = H.MBR_SN WHERE H.BTCH_SE_CD = #{btchSeCd} ORDER BY H.EXCN_BGNG_DT DESC , H.BTCH_EXCN_HSTRY_SN DESC
